title: Chiisana Kyojin Microman
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 392061 and TMDB show 26574. Its episodes are on TMDB show 26574. AniDB episode 1-52 ("宇宙から来たミクロ戦士" (The Micro-soldiers Who Arrived From Space) to "命ある限り!! スーパーマグネパワー全開!!" (Episode 52)) are TMDB S1E1 "小さな巨人ミクロマン" (The Micro-soldiers Who Arrived From Space) to TMDB S1E52 "命ある限り!!スーパーマグネパワー全開!!". TMDB 26574 season 1 Microman (1999) has 52 episodes whose titles 1-10 equal AniDB's English titles word for word, all with AniDB's air dates; TVDB 392061 carries only the 1999 film.
